name: Risograph and halftone print
look: 2 to 3 spot inks on cream paper, off-register, grain, dot screens, overprint multiply.

fits.notes: indie, design, creative, community, editorial products

products: products needing exact brand colours beyond 3 inks

when_not: Avoid when colours must be exact brand (limit to 3 inks anyway).

type.guidance: Bricolage, Cooper, GT Sectra, Space Grotesk
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: Bricolage, Cooper, GT Sectra, Space Grotesk; fluorescent pink, blue, yellow, green on cream.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: brand colour is ink A; ink B is a supporting hue; paper is cream
brand_lock.type_role: Bricolage / Cooper / Space Grotesk class for display, brand face for the claim
brand_lock.world_changes: plate-by-plate reveal on cream paper with registration wobble
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects.role: two-ink print with off-register; ink A is the brand colour

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: two-colour separation illustration of {subject}: spot colour layers, black plate separate, cream paper, grain
codex_assets.r1_note: 2-colour-separation illustrations (ask "spot colour layers, black plate separate"), grain textures; A5 boil.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.recipe: `styles/riso.md`, `halftone-dossier.md`, `systems/material/risograph-print.md`, `movements/risograph-culture.md`. Canvas halftone: sample luminance on a rotated grid, draw circles; `mix-blend-mode: multiply`; SVG `feTurbulence` grain; GSAP offsets per plate.

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.
